safety_guards: rejects heroes not owned by user with 404
rejects heroes in active team with 400
backend_contract_audit.reward_formula: base SOUL_ESSENCE_VALUES[1-5] * (1 + level*0.02), level bonus rate 2% per level. Same as frontend calcEssence preview function.
backend_contract_audit.conclusion: BACKEND CONTRACT IS CORRECT AND MATCHES FRONTEND EXPECTATIONS. No backend changes required.

frontend_crash_candidates.scenario: If response is malformed (missing new_balance) or apiCall returns null body, setBalance(undefined) is committed to state. Next render of header balance badge does {balance.toLocaleString()} which throws TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined.
frontend_crash_candidates.fix: Normalize response with fallback chain (Number(r?.new_balance ?? r?.balance ?? r?.soul_essence ?? balance)). Validate before setBalance. Never setBalance(non-finite).

frontend_crash_candidates.scenario: If r.new_balance is undefined and we setResult({gained: ..., newBalance: undefined}), the conditional render passes (gained>0) and then renders newBalance.toLocaleString() -> CRASH.
frontend_crash_candidates.fix: Render with (result.newBalance ?? 0).toLocaleString() AND normalize at setResult time.

frontend_crash_candidates.scenario: Heroes removed from UI optimistically without validating response success. If backend returned 200 with malformed payload, UI state becomes inconsistent.
frontend_crash_candidates.fix: Only remove heroes after response normalization validates gained_essence >= 0 AND server says success.

frontend_crash_candidates.scenario: On API failure, the error message is swallowed. User sees no feedback because result.gained === 0 fails the conditional render.
frontend_crash_candidates.fix: Introduce dedicated errorMessage state shown as a visible card in the forge panel after a failed forge.

frontend_crash_candidates.code_path: confirmForge button onPress (not guarded by 'forging' state explicitly)
frontend_crash_candidates.scenario: User could double-tap CONFERMA before forging flips. Already partially mitigated because setConfirmOpen(false) hides the modal, but defensive guard recommended.
frontend_crash_candidates.fix: Add 'if (forging) return;' at the top of confirmForge.

track_B_response_normalization: Add normalizeForgeResponse() helper that accepts multiple field aliases (gained_essence|gained|essence_gained, new_balance|balance|soul_essence)
Validate gained is a finite number >= 0; if not, treat as failure
Validate newBalance is a finite number >= 0; if not, fall back to balance + gained
Only mutate state (setBalance, setHeroes) after validation passes
Introduce errorMessage state shown in a red error card with retry semantics
On error: keep selected heroes intact (user can retry without re-picking)
track_D_modal_and_post_success: Add 'if (forging) return;' double-submit guard in confirmForge
Refresh failures after success show a soft warning but DO NOT crash
